tools.name: write_memory
tools.description: Save a durable memory entry. No approval required.

function.name: write_memory
function.description: Save a memory entry to long-term memory.

topic.description: Legacy optional field. Ignored; all memory is stored in memory.md.

tools.name: search_memories
tools.description: Search stored long-term memories for relevant context.

function.name: search_memories
function.description: Search long-term memory for relevant notes.

max_results.description: Optional hint for how much memory to return.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file from the vault using a vault-relative path. Returns numbered lines and supports optional line ranges.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the vault using a vault-relative path.

path.description: Vault-relative path to the file, like Daily Notes/2026-04-18.md or scene.js.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a text file inside the vault using a vault-relative path. Existing files preview first unless confirm=true is provided.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write UTF-8 text into a vault file using a vault-relative path.

path.description: Vault-relative path to the file, like Projects/todo.md.

create_parents.description: Whether to create missing parent directories. Defaults to true.

confirm.description: Set to true to overwrite an existing file after previewing it.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Hidden compatibility alias for legacy callers. Prefer replace_text_in_file or edit_code_symbol.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Edit a UTF-8 text file in the vault by replacing exact text, or by AST-aware replacement when target_name and target_type are provided for .py, .js, or .ts files.

old_text.description: Exact text to find. Required for exact-match edits; ignored when target_name and target_type are provided.

target_name.description: Name of the function, method, or variable to edit. For methods, format is ClassName.methodName. When provided with target_type, enables AST-aware editing for .py, .js, .ts files.

target_type.description: Type of target for AST editing. Use with target_name.

replace_all.description: When true, replace all matches. Defaults to false. Only applies to exact-match edits.

tools.name: append_file
tools.description: Append text to a vault file using a vault-relative path. Use for reminders, todos, logs, and notes.

function.name: append_file
function.description: Append UTF-8 text to a vault file using a vault-relative path.

create_parents.description: Whether to create missing parent directories. Defaults to true.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files in the vault using a vault-relative path.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List files in the vault using a vault-relative path.

path.description: Vault-relative directory path. Defaults to vault root.

include_dirs.description: Whether to include directories. Defaults to true.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search text files in the vault without using the terminal.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search UTF-8 text files in the vault.

path.description: Vault-relative directory or file path. Defaults to vault root.

file_glob.description: Optional glob for vault-relative file paths.

tools.name: replace_text_in_file
tools.description: Replace exact text in a vault file using a vault-relative path.

function.name: replace_text_in_file
function.description: Replace exact text in a UTF-8 vault file.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false.

tools.name: edit_code_symbol
tools.description: Replace a Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript function, method, or variable in a vault file.

function.name: edit_code_symbol
function.description: Edit a code symbol in a Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript vault file.

target_name.description: Symbol name. For methods use ClassName.methodName.

tools.name: add_reminder
tools.description: Add a one-off reminder to the scheduler. Use when the user asks to be reminded at a future date or time.

function.name: add_reminder
function.description: Add a one-off reminder for a specific future time. Pass due_at as ISO or natural English such as tomorrow at 9 AM, today 6:15 PM, next Friday noon, Thursday 5pm, or May 5 at 8 AM.

text.description: What the user wants to be reminded about.

due_at.description: Future reminder time as ISO or natural English, e.g. 2026-05-02T10:00:00, tomorrow at 9 AM, next Friday noon, or May 5 at 8 AM.

tools.name: add_recurring_reminder
tools.description: Add a recurring reminder to the scheduler. Use when the user asks for reminders that repeat every N days, weeks, months, years, or on a weekday/month day.

function.name: add_recurring_reminder
function.description: Add a recurring reminder. If either text or schedule is missing or unclear, call with the known field and ask the user for the missing detail before calling again.

text.description: What the user wants to be reminded about.

schedule.description: Recurring schedule as DSL or natural English, e.g. daily 5pm, every morning, every Monday, every other Monday at 9 AM, every 3 days 09:00, every month on the 15th at noon, or every year on April 21 at 10 AM.

tools.name: snooze_reminder
tools.description: Snooze a reminder that just fired. Use when the user asks to be reminded later, tomorrow, or at a specific future time after a reminder has fired.

function.name: snooze_reminder
function.description: Snooze a reminder that just fired to a later time.

reminder_id.description: The reminder ID from the reminder_fired event

until.description: ISO datetime string for when to re-fire the reminder e.g. 2026-04-22T09:00:00

tools.name: help_skill
tools.description: Read the full content of a skill by name. Use this before following any skill workflow.

function.name: help_skill
function.description: Read the full content of a skill by name.

layer.description: Layer the skill belongs to: companion, assistant, or shared. Omit to search all layers.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List available skill files with descriptions. Filter by layer if needed.

function.name: list_skills
function.description: List available skill files with descriptions, optionally filtered by layer.

layer.description: Filter by layer: companion, assistant, shared, or all.

tools.name: write_skill
tools.description: Create or overwrite a skill file. Skills are markdown workflow guides and must start with frontmatter that includes purpose, tools, syntax, and args.

function.name: write_skill
function.description: Create or overwrite a skill markdown file in the given layer.

layer.description: Layer to write to: companion, assistant, or shared.

tools.name: delete_skill
tools.description: Delete a skill file. It stops appearing in the skill registry on the next turn.

function.name: delete_skill
function.description: Delete a skill file from the given layer.

tools.name: run_windows_terminal
tools.description: Run a command on the Windows host. Approval required because this can affect the real PC.

function.name: run_windows_terminal
function.description: Run a command on the Windows host using PowerShell by default, or cmd if requested.

command.description: Windows command to run on the host.

shell.description: Optional shell: powershell or cmd. Defaults to powershell.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds, capped by the backend.

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Get the current date and time. No approval required.

function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Return the current date and time as a formatted string.

tools.name: get_system_info
tools.description: Get OS, machine, user, and processor information. No approval required.

function.name: get_system_info
function.description: Return OS version, machine name, logged-in user, architecture, and processor.

tools.name: set_volume
tools.description: Set the system volume to a specific level (0–100). No approval required.

function.name: set_volume
function.description: Set the Windows system volume level.

tools.name: mute_volume
tools.description: Toggle system mute on or off. No approval required.

function.name: mute_volume
function.description: Toggle the Windows system mute.

tools.name: open_application
tools.description: Open an application on the Windows host. Approval required.

function.name: open_application
function.description: Launch an application by name on the Windows host.

name.description: Application name or executable to launch, e.g. notepad, chrome, spotify.

tools.name: copy_to_clipboard
tools.description: Copy text to the Windows clipboard. No approval required.

function.name: copy_to_clipboard
function.description: Copy a string of text to the Windows clipboard.

text.description: Text to copy to the clipboard.

tools.name: read_clipboard
tools.description: Read the current contents of the Windows clipboard. No approval required.

function.name: read_clipboard
function.description: Return the current text content of the Windows clipboard.

tools.name: get_cpu_usage
tools.description: Get the current CPU usage percentage. No approval required.

function.name: get_cpu_usage
function.description: Return current CPU usage as a percentage.

tools.name: get_ram_usage
tools.description: Get current RAM usage in GB and as a percentage. No approval required.

function.name: get_ram_usage
function.description: Return current RAM used vs total and usage percentage.

tools.name: get_disk_space
tools.description: Get disk usage for all mounted drives. No approval required.

function.name: get_disk_space
function.description: Return used and total disk space for each mounted drive.

tools.name: get_battery
tools.description: Get the battery charge level and charging status. No approval required.

function.name: get_battery
function.description: Return battery percentage and whether the device is plugged in.

tools.name: get_running_processes
tools.description: Get the top running processes by CPU usage. No approval required.

function.name: get_running_processes
function.description: Return the top running processes sorted by CPU usage.

tools.name: set_timer
tools.description: Set a countdown timer that shows a popup when it expires. No approval required.

function.name: set_timer
function.description: Start a background countdown timer that pops up a Windows notification when it expires.

minutes.description: Number of minutes for the timer (optional).

label.description: Label shown in the popup when the timer expires. Defaults to 'Timer'.

tools.name: move_companion_window
tools.description: Move the companion overlay window to a position or display. No approval required.

function.name: move_companion_window
function.description: Move the companion window to a named position, by absolute coordinates, or by offset.

position.description: Named position: center, top_left, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_right. Defaults to center.

display.description: Target display: current, primary, secondary. Defaults to current.

x.description: Absolute X coordinate to move the window to (optional).

y.description: Absolute Y coordinate to move the window to (optional).

dx.description: Horizontal offset in pixels to move relative to current position (optional).

dy.description: Vertical offset in pixels to move relative to current position (optional).

tools.name: run_terminal
tools.description: Run a shell command inside the companion's Ubuntu WSL sandbox. Working directory is /home/companion/vault. No approval required.

function.name: run_terminal
function.description: Run a shell command inside the Ubuntu WSL sandbox at /home/companion/vault.

command.description: Shell command to run in the sandbox. Use plain terminal commands like cat, ls, grep, sed, printf, and heredocs.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds, capped by the backend.
